name: After recital 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: (1a) The continuing conflict in Ukraine has entailed grave human suffering and substantial humanitarian needs. The Union should intensify its diplomatic efforts, including by considering the appointment of a dedicated peace envoy, with a view to facilitating an immediate cessation of hostilities and a negotiated settlement. Public resources should give priority to the protection of people, the provision of essential services and social resilience.
